description:
Session Flow types of the Dex Agents CLI. A runtime registers <harness Flow type>-<suffix>. The suffix is 6 lowercase base36 characters (0-9a-z): take the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text "<host_name>
<user_id>
<config_identity>
<workspace>", read its first 8 bytes as an unsigned big-endian integer, reduce it modulo 36^6 (2176782336), write the remainder in base36 with lowercase letters, and left-pad it with 0 to 6 characters. Every CLI runtime must produce flow_type from harness_flow_type and the four inputs of each case. Hand-written; see README.md and agents/cli/README.md.

cases.name: ascii-defaults
cases.description: A POSIX user ID, no configuration file.

cases.name: ascii-config-file
cases.description: A configuration file and a project workspace.

cases.name: another-user
cases.description: The same paths as ascii-config-file under another user ID.

cases.name: windows-user-name
cases.description: A user name where the system has no numeric user ID, with Windows paths.

cases.name: unicode-host-name
cases.description: A host name and workspace outside ASCII, hashed as UTF-8.

cases.name: unicode-paths
cases.description: CJK and emoji paths, hashed as UTF-8.

cases.name: left-padded
cases.description: A remainder below 36**5, so the suffix starts with 0.
